column2: After the storm passed, he sat by the window in a quiet muse about his future.
column3: 暴風雨過後，他坐在窗邊，靜靜沉思自己的未來。
column4: lost in a muse (陷入沉思)
column5: muse 諧音「謬思」：腦中冒出謬妙的思緒

column2: The restaurant serves roast mutton with mint sauce, a classic English dish.
column3: 這家餐廳供應搭配薄荷醬的烤羊肉，是一道經典的英國菜。
column5: mutton 諧音「馬騰」：馬騰草原上的羊肉

column2: Some people believe the myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
column3: 有些人相信一種迷思，認為我們只用了百分之十的腦。
column5: myth 諧音「迷思」：一個迷人的思想故事，不一定真

column2: The evening newscast began with a report on a typhoon heading toward Taiwan.
column3: 晚間新聞廣播一開始就報導了一個朝台灣前進的颱風。
column4: the evening newscast (晚間新聞廣播)
column5: news 新聞 + cast 播送：把新聞播送出去

column2: Poets have long praised the nightingale for singing sweetly in the dark.
column3: 詩人長久以來讚美夜鶯在黑暗中甜美歌唱。
column5: night 夜 + in + gale 風：夜風中歌唱的鳥

column2: The dog pressed its wet nose to the door, and its nostril flared at the smell of food.
column3: 那隻狗把濕鼻子貼在門上，聞到食物香味時鼻孔張大。
column5: nose 鼻子 + tril：鼻子上的兩個洞，口訣「no-stril」

column2: She had no notion of how far the village was from the station.
column3: 她完全不知道那個村莊離車站有多遠。
column4: have no notion of (毫無概念)
column5: note 注意 + ion：腦中記下一個想法

column2: Even a novice can learn to ride a bike after a few careful lessons.
column3: 即使是新手，上過幾堂小心的課之後也能學會騎腳踏車。
column5: nov 新 + ice：像剛結的新冰，還很新手

column2: He pulled hard on the oar, and the little boat shot across the lake.
column3: 他用力划槳，小船迅速掠過湖面。
column4: row with an oar (用槳划船)
column5: oar 諧音「歐」：歐！歐！划船喊著號子

column2: An observer from the museum watched the birds nest without disturbing them.
column3: 一位來自博物館的觀察員看著鳥築巢，沒有打擾牠們。
column4: a careful observer (細心的觀察者)
column5: observe 觀察 + er：負責看的人

column2: Earthquakes are a rare occurrence in this quiet part of the country.
column3: 地震在這個國家平靜的地區是罕見的事件。
column5: occur 發生 + rence：就是發生的事或發生這回事

column2: The odds of winning the lottery are about one in many millions.
column3: 中樂透的機率大約是好幾百萬分之一。
column4: against all odds (儘管機會渺茫)
column5: odds 諧音「噁的」：機率低到噁心

column2: A strange odor from the fridge told us the milk had gone bad.
column3: 冰箱傳出一股怪味，告訴我們牛奶已經壞掉了。
column5: odor 諧音「噢的」：噢，好臭的氣味

column2: The tennis player shook hands with her opponent after the long match.
column3: 網球選手在漫長的比賽後，與她的對手握手。
column4: a worthy opponent (旗鼓相當的對手)
column5: op 相對 + pon 放：放在對面的人

column2: Her optimism helped the team stay calm even when the plan went wrong.
column3: 即使計畫出錯，她的樂觀仍幫助團隊保持冷靜。
column5: optimum 最好 + ism：相信最好的會發生

column2: In spring, the apple orchard behind the farm is covered with white blossoms.
column3: 春天時，農場後面的蘋果園開滿白花。
column5: or 諧音「喔」+ chard：喔！整片果樹長在一起

column2: He bought a leather organizer to keep his schedule and notes together.
column3: 他買了一本皮製記事本，把行程和筆記放在一起。
column5: organize 整理 + r：幫你把事情理順的本子

column2: The children at the orphanage were thrilled when volunteers brought them new books.
column3: 當志工帶新書給孤兒院的孩子們時，他們興奮不已。
column4: live in an orphanage (住在孤兒院)
column5: orphan 孤兒 + age：收留孤兒的機構

column2: The zoo's ostrich can run faster than most cars on a country road.
column3: 動物園的駝鳥跑起來比鄉間公路上的大多數汽車還快。
column5: ostrich 諧音「鴕斯趣」：遇事把頭埋沙裡的鳥

column2: The recipe calls for eight ounces of flour and two ounces of butter.
column3: 食譜需要八盎司的麵粉和兩盎司的奶油。
column4: an ounce of gold (一盎司黃金)
column5: ounce 諧音「盎司」：直接用音記，一盎司約二十八公克

column2: As an outsider, he felt nervous at the first meeting of the village club.
column3: 身為局外人，他在村裡社團的第一次聚會感到緊張。
column4: an outsider's view (局外人的觀點)
column5: out 外面 + sider：站在圈子外面的人

column2: She handed me a packet of seeds and told me to plant them in spring.
column3: 她遞給我一小包種子，叫我春天把它們種下。
column4: a packet of seeds (一小包種子)
column5: pack 包 + et 小：小小的一包

column2: A soccer ball cracked the window pane, and glass fell onto the kitchen floor.
column3: 一顆足球打裂了窗玻璃，碎片掉到廚房地板上。
column5: pane 跟 pain 同音，但是窗玻璃片，打破它才會 pain

column2: Guests waited in the parlor while the family finished setting the table.
column3: 客人在客廳等候，而家人正擺好餐桌。
column5: parl 說話 + or：用來說話接待客人的房間

column2: Every participant in the race received a small medal and a bottle of water.
column3: 比賽的每位參與者都得到一面小獎牌和一瓶水。
column4: a participant in the race (比賽參與者)
column5: part 一部分 + icip + ant：成為活動一部分的人

column2: Dust particles floated in the beam of sunlight shining through the curtains.
column3: 灰塵微粒漂浮在穿過窗簾的陽光光束中。
column5: part 一部分 + icle 小：小小的一部分

column2: The bakery's flaky pastry is filled with sweet red bean paste.
column3: 這家麵包店的酥皮點心裡包著香甜的紅豆餡。
column5: pasty 黏糊 + pastry 烤出酥皮，paste 麵糊烤成點心

column2: The patriot gave a speech urging everyone to love and protect their homeland.
column3: 這位愛國者發表演說，呼籲大家愛護並保衛自己的家園。
column4: a true patriot (真正的愛國者)
column5: patr 父親 + iot：父親之地祖國，愛祖國的人

column2: The peasant rose before dawn to plow the field and feed the oxen.
column3: 那位農夫天亮前就起床耕田並餵牛。
column5: peasant 諧音「皮仔特」：種田的皮膚曬黑的人

column2: A peddler pushed his cart through the street, calling out the price of his oranges.
column3: 一名小販推著車走過街道，吆喝橘子的價錢。
column5: ped 腳：用腳走街串巷賣東西的人

column2: The young performer bowed to the audience after finishing her violin piece.
column3: 年輕的演奏者拉完小提琴曲後向觀眾鞠躬。
column5: perform 表演 + er：上台表演的人

column2: All airport personnel must wear a badge so travelers can identify them easily.
column3: 所有機場人員都必須佩戴識別證，旅客才能輕易認出他們。
column5: person 人 + nel：一群人的集合就是人員

column2: His pessimism made him expect the worst, even when the weather forecast looked fine.
column3: 他的悲觀讓他即使在天氣預報看起來良好時，也預期最糟的情況。
column5: pessimist 悲觀者 + ism，是 optimism 的反義

column2: Pilgrims walked for weeks to reach the holy shrine on the hill.
column3: 朝聖者走了好幾週，才抵達山丘上的聖地。
column4: a pilgrim on the road (朝聖路上的人)
column5: pilgrim 諧音「皮格林」：腳底磨皮還要走去聖地

column2: Before the school photo, she covered a pimple on her chin with a bit of cream.
column3: 拍學校團體照前，她用一點乳霜遮住下巴上的一顆痘痘。
column4: a pimple on the nose (鼻子上的痘痘)
column5: pimple 諧音「皮膚破」：青春期皮膚冒出小丘疹

column2: In the Middle Ages, a plague spread quickly through crowded towns across Europe.
column3: 中世紀時，瘟疫迅速傳遍歐洲擁擠的城鎮。
column5: plague 諧音「普累」：瘟疫讓人普遍累倒

column2: Workers on the sugar plantation rose early to cut cane under the hot sun.
column3: 糖業大農園的工人很早起床，在烈日下割甘蔗。
column5: plant 種植 + ation：大面積種植作物的地方

column2: The playwright spent two years writing a comedy that finally opened in Taipei.
column3: 這位劇作家花了兩年寫一齣喜劇，終於在台北上演。
column5: play 戲劇 + wright 工匠：打造戲劇的工匠

column2: The child's plea for another chance softened the teacher's strict face.
column3: 孩子懇求再給一次機會，讓老師嚴厲的臉色緩和下來。
column4: a plea for help (求助的呼籲)
column5: plea 跟 please 很像，懇求時一直 please

column2: He kept a tiny pocketbook in his coat with a few bills and coins.
column3: 他在外套裡放了一個小皮夾，裡面有幾張鈔票和硬幣。
column5: pocket 口袋 + book 本子：放口袋裡的本形皮夾
